title: Alltag und Arbeit
description: Tell the time with full and half hours, name the days and the parts of the day, describe your daily routine, talk about work and the German course, use classroom phrases when you do not understand, say what you must and want to do, and make or change a simple appointment. Grammar: clock times with um and am, separable verbs, and the modal verbs müssen and wollen beside können and möchten.
